question.en: What is Debbie going to try to do?

sentences.en: What is Debbie going to try to do?
Debbie Hart is going to swim across the English Channel tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 黛比·哈特准备明天横渡英吉利海峡。

sentences.en: She is going to set out from the French coast at five o'clock in the morning.
sentences.zh: 她准备早上5点从法国海岸出发。

sentences.en: Debbie is only eleven years old and she hopes to set up a new world record.
sentences.zh: 黛比只有11岁，她希望创造一项新的世界纪录。

sentences.en: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel that she is sure to succeed.
sentences.zh: 她游泳很强，许多人觉得她一定会成功。

sentences.en: Debbie's father will set out with her in a small boat.
sentences.zh: 黛比的父亲将乘一条小船和她一起出发。

sentences.en: Mr. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
sentences.zh: 哈特先生训练女儿已有好几年了。

sentences.en: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously as she swims the long distance to England.
sentences.zh: 明天他将焦急地注视着她游完到英国的那段漫长距离。

sentences.en: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
sentences.zh: 黛比打算每两小时休息片刻。

sentences.en: She will have something to drink but she will not eat any solid food.
sentences.zh: 她会喝点东西，但不吃任何固体食物。

sentences.en: Most of Debbie's school friends will be waiting for her on the English coast.
sentences.zh: 黛比的大多数同学将在英国海岸等她。

sentences.en: Among them will be Debbie's mother, who swam the Channel herself when she was a girl.
sentences.zh: 其中有黛比的母亲，她自己小时候曾横渡过英吉利海峡。
